g.text: Rastok M0 — bird's-eye module overview (companion to 05, no members)
node address — enters the id recipes
in / out / err and inferred ports
what fired a transaction — p: or l:
lazy encoded bytes, or a value born in memory
where it was born — parse … sim
the names visible at one position
name lookup the runtime adapts onto
cel's own — adapted by the compiler
desugared, resolved, typed — the hash input
the compiled operator graph the VM interprets
a guest's pinned identity + purity contract
executes calls ; answers or stays silent
the only source of time, one event at a time
internal call identity — derived, not stored
the world entered — root recipe complete
the envelope, born in the accept
recovery — replays the journal into state
the first real partner — child processes
drives the VM through a scenario
One line per type ; no fields, no methods, no type-level arrows.
Base modules `node`, `envelope`, `diag` are used by every module
«next» = APIs kept ready, not built in M0 ;
